ai_summary: Andhra Paper Limited's 62nd Annual General Meeting, held virtually on August 11, 2026, proposes a final dividend of ₹0.50 per equity share for FY 2025-26. A key resolution includes the re-appointment of Mr. Saurabh Bangur as Managing Director for five years, notably with a provision allowing for his remuneration even if the company has "no profits or its profits are inadequate," which warrants careful shareholder consideration. Additionally, dividend income will now be subject to Tax Deducted at Source (TDS) for shareholders, making KYC and PAN updates crucial for receiving payments and availing tax benefits.
